column1: # Whisperfile variants from Mozilla's Hugging Face repo.
# All three rows are .en (English-only) variants; multilingual variants
# — add rows here if needed. small.en is today's default — Mozilla removed
# the previous base.en variant from the repo as of 2026-05.
# Sizes are exact bytes from x-linked-size headers (verified 2026-05-08).
Tiny.en (~87 MB — fastest, weak accuracy; fine for 8 GB hosts)
Small.en (~497 MB — balanced default; fits 8 GB hosts alongside E4B)
Medium.en (~1.8 GB — best accuracy; pick only if host has ≥16 GB RAM)
